newsitem.title: USA: Mac Frugal's Bargains Nov sales up 8.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mac Frugal's Bargains Nov sales up 8.0 pct.

text.p: Mac Frugal's Bargains Close-Outs Inc said its sales for the four weeks ended November 24, 1996 were $72.7 million, up 8.0 percent from $67.3 million in the prior year.
Sales in comparable stores for the four weeks were up 6.0 percent, it said without providing any figures.
The company said total sales for the 43 weeks year-to-date were $564.1 million, an increase of 8.4 percent from $520.5 million in the prior year.
Year-to-date comparable store sales were up 3.8 percent, it said.
The company operates a chain of 319 retail stores in 18 states, selling general merchandise obtained through manufacturer close-outs, overruns, discontinued lines and packaging changes.
